sql: select * from "learning_v2_attempts" where "id" = $1 and "user_id" = $2 for update

select "content_assets"."status" as "asset_status", "content_items"."status" as "content_status", "content_items"."catalog_visibility" from "content_assets" inner join "content_items" on "content_items"."id" = "content_assets"."content_item_id" where "content_assets"."id" = $1

select "learning_resources"."retired_at", "content_items"."status", "content_items"."catalog_visibility" from "learning_resource_revisions" inner join "learning_resources" on "learning_resources"."id" = "learning_resource_revisions"."resource_id" inner join "content_items" on "content_items"."id" = "learning_resources"."source_content_id" where "learning_resource_revisions"."id" = $1
select count(*) as "count" from "learning_mutation_receipts" where "user_id" = $1 and "created_at" > $2 and response_json->>'rateLimitV2' = $3

insert into "learning_mutation_receipts" ("user_id", "idempotency_key", "request_hash", "response_json", "http_status") values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) on conflict ("user_id", "idempotency_key") do nothing returning "idempotency_key"
select * from "learning_v2_attempts" where "id" = $1 and "user_id" = $2 for update

select "content_assets"."status" as "asset_status", "content_items"."status" as "content_status", "content_items"."catalog_visibility" from "content_assets" inner join "content_items" on "content_items"."id" = "content_assets"."content_item_id" where "content_assets"."id" = $1

select "learning_resources"."retired_at", "content_items"."status", "content_items"."catalog_visibility" from "learning_resource_revisions" inner join "learning_resources" on "learning_resources"."id" = "learning_resource_revisions"."resource_id" inner join "content_items" on "content_items"."id" = "learning_resources"."source_content_id" where "learning_resource_revisions"."id" = $1
update "learning_v2_attempts" set "resume_json" = $1, "row_version" = row_version + 1, "updated_at" = $2 where "id" = $3 and "row_version" = $4 returning *

insert into "learning_v2_activity_state" ("enrollment_id", "user_id", "path_version_id", "activity_key", "state", "evidence_attempt_id") values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6) on conflict ("enrollment_id", "path_version_id", "activity_key") do update set "state" = $7, "evidence_attempt_id" = $8, "row_version" = learning_v2_activity_state.row_version + 1, "updated_at" = $9
select * from "learning_v2_attempts" where "user_id" = $1 and "enrollment_id" = $2 and "path_version_id" in ($3) order by "created_at"
select * from "learning_v2_responses" where "user_id" = $1 and "enrollment_id" = $2 and "path_version_id" in ($3)
select * from "learning_events" where "user_id" = $1 and "enrollment_id" = $2 and "policy_version" = $3 order by "occurred_at", "id"
select * from "learning_v2_review_state" where "user_id" = $1 and "path_version_id" = $2 order by "objective_key" for update
select "objective_key" from "learning_v2_review_state" where "user_id" = $1 and "enrollment_id" = $2 and "path_version_id" = $3 and "due_at" <= $4
select * from "learning_v2_objective_state" where "user_id" = $1 and "enrollment_id" = $2 and "path_version_id" = $3 order by "objective_key" for update

select "content_assets"."status" as "asset_status", "content_items"."status" as "content_status", "content_items"."catalog_visibility" from "content_assets" inner join "content_items" on "content_items"."id" = "content_assets"."content_item_id" where "content_assets"."id" = $1

select "learning_resources"."retired_at", "content_items"."status", "content_items"."catalog_visibility" from "learning_resource_revisions" inner join "learning_resources" on "learning_resources"."id" = "learning_resource_revisions"."resource_id" inner join "content_items" on "content_items"."id" = "learning_resources"."source_content_id" where "learning_resource_revisions"."id" = $1
select * from "learning_v2_attempts" where "user_id" = $1 and "enrollment_id" = $2 and "path_version_id" in ($3) order by "created_at"
select * from "learning_v2_responses" where "user_id" = $1 and "enrollment_id" = $2 and "path_version_id" in ($3)
select * from "learning_events" where "user_id" = $1 and "enrollment_id" = $2 and "policy_version" = $3 order by "occurred_at", "id"
select * from "learning_v2_review_state" where "user_id" = $1 and "path_version_id" = $2 order by "objective_key" for update
select "objective_key" from "learning_v2_review_state" where "user_id" = $1 and "enrollment_id" = $2 and "path_version_id" = $3 and "due_at" <= $4
select * from "learning_v2_objective_state" where "user_id" = $1 and "enrollment_id" = $2 and "path_version_id" = $3 order by "objective_key" for update
select * from "learning_events" where "user_id" = $1 and "enrollment_id" = $2 and "policy_version" = $3 and "occurred_at" <= $4

select "learning_enrollment_versions"."path_version_id", "learning_enrollment_versions"."previous_version_id", "learning_enrollment_versions"."adopted_at", "learning_enrollment_versions"."mapping_json", "learning_path_versions"."version_number", "learning_path_versions"."policy_version" from "learning_enrollment_versions" inner join "learning_path_versions" on "learning_path_versions"."id" = "learning_enrollment_versions"."path_version_id" where "learning_enrollment_versions"."enrollment_id" = $1 order by "learning_path_versions"."version_number"
